svg.data-weight: 4.6 kg (10 lb) for the EX3300-24T and 4.5 kg (9.8 lb) for the EX3300-24T-DC (Table 5)
svg.data-width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in.) with the mounting brackets attached (Table 5)
svg.data-power-current-max: 1.8 A at 100 VAC and 0.5 A at 230 VAC for a switch with no PoE ports (Table 15)
svg.data-power-input-dc: -43 through -75 VDC, 2 A maximum, for the EX3300-24T-DC (Table 16)
svg.data-cooling: two fans, one along the rear and one along the left side of the chassis (Cooling System)
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 3048 m (10,000 ft) (Table 19)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches. Uplink ports 2 and 3 are Virtual Chassis ports by default and ports 0 and 1 are network ports
svg.data-uplink-ports: four SFP or SFP+ ports on the front
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the uplink ports take SFP and SFP+ transceivers, singly or mixed (Pluggable Transceivers Supported on EX3300 Switches, page 61)
svg.data-oob: management Ethernet RJ-45 on the rear panel, with a Link/Activity lamp and a Status lamp
svg.data-console: RJ-45 console on the rear panel
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear panel
svg.data-lcd: LCD panel with two lines of 16 characters and Menu and Enter buttons
svg.data-seismic: Complies with Zone 4 earthquake requirements as per GR-63, Issue 4 (Table 19)
